Get started with shadshiny

Source: vignettes/shadshiny.Rmd
shadshiny.Rmd

shadshiny is a port of the shadcn/ui design system to Shiny. Components are plain htmltools tags backed by one bundled asset dependency — there is no npm step and no React. Bound components behave like ordinary Shiny inputs.

Install 

pak::pak("orijitghosh/shadshiny")

The page wrapper

Every app starts with page_shad(). It attaches the shadshiny asset bundle, establishes the theme scope, and otherwise behaves like a Shiny page. Pass a theme_preset to choose one of the seven palettes.

library(shiny)
library(shadshiny)

page_shad(
  theme_preset = "violet",
  # ... UI ...
)

A first form

Components take an inputId and read back through input$<inputId> exactly like base Shiny inputs. shad_input(), shad_select(), and shad_checkbox() below each contribute one reactive value.

library(shiny)
library(shadshiny)

ui <- page_shad(
  theme_preset = "violet",
  shad_card(
    shad_card_header(
      shad_card_title("Create account"),
      shad_card_description("It only takes a minute.")
    ),
    shad_card_content(
      shad_input("email", label = "Email", type = "email",
                 placeholder = "you@example.com"),
      shad_select("plan", label = "Plan",
                  choices = c(Free = "free", Pro = "pro", Team = "team"),
                  selected = "pro"),
      shad_checkbox("tos", label = "I accept the terms")
    ),
    shad_card_footer(
      shad_button(inputId = "submit", "Sign up"),
      shad_button(inputId = "reset", "Reset", variant = "outline")
    )
  ),
  verbatimTextOutput("out")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Read values straight off `input$`.
  output$out <- renderPrint(
    list(email = input$email, plan = input$plan, tos = input$tos)
  )

  # Update a component from the server with its `update_shad_*()` helper.
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    update_shad_select("plan", selected = "free")
    update_shad_checkbox("tos", value = FALSE)
  })

  # Open an overlay and raise a toast.
  observeEvent(input$submit, {
    if (!isTRUE(input$tos)) {
      shad_toast_error("Please accept the terms first.")
    } else {
      shad_toast_success(paste("Welcome,", input$email))
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Reading and updating values

  • Read: input$email, input$plan, input$tos. Value shapes match what the component holds — a string, a logical, a vector for multi-selects.
  • Update: each valued component has an update_shad_*() twin (update_shad_select(), update_shad_checkbox(), …). They accept the same inputId and are Shiny-module safe.

Overlays and toasts

Overlays such as shad_dialog() can be driven by a trigger element in the UI or opened from the server with shad_dialog_open(id). Toasts are entirely server-side: shad_toast() and its shad_toast_success() / _error() / _warning() / _loading() shorthands.

shad_dialog(
  "confirm",
  trigger = shad_button("Open"),
  title = "Are you sure?",
  shad_p("This action can be undone."),
  footer = shad_dialog_close_button("Close")
)
